title: The biggest modding site in PC gaming is taking a stance on AI
slides: Why is Nexus Mods drawing a line on AI?
It hosts mods for thousands of PC games
It will ban AI-generated content and tools
Modders must disclose any AI use honestly
Check your favorite mods for new AI rules
thread_text:
1. Nexus Mods bans AI content

Nexus Mods hosts mods for thousands of PC games. It just drew a hard line on AI-generated content and tools, banning them outright.

2. Modders must disclose AI use

Any modder using AI must honestly disclose it. This transparency rule applies to all mods on the platform.

3. Check your favorite mods

Existing mods may now be affected by the new AI rules. Check your favorite mods for compliance updates.

4. Why the sudden crackdown?

Nexus Mods hasn't detailed its full reasoning, but the move signals growing tension over AI in gaming communities.

5. What's your take?

Do you support banning AI-generated mods, or should platforms allow them with disclosure? Tell us in the replies.
